user.title: Choose a speaker
user.description: Pick the media player to manage: a Sonos, HomePod, Google or Nest speaker, Echo, Music Assistant player or any other.

settings.title: Speaker rules
settings.description: Rules for {entity}. You can change all of this later in the Media Mgmt sidebar app, which also has schedules and sleep timers.

listening.name: Listening time
listening.description: A daily limit, and times music must stay off.

data_description.daily_budget: 0 means no daily limit. Only time spent playing counts, not paused time.
data_description.warn_minutes: Fires a media_mgmt_warning event, and says it on the speaker if warnings are set up.
data_description.quiet_windows: Times music stays off, comma separated, e.g. 20:30-07:00 Bedtime, 08:00-15:00 School. Schedules can still play during them.
data_description.limit_action: What happens when the limit runs out, a quiet window starts or you block the speaker.
data_description.adult_mode_duration: How long the adult mode switch lifts every rule before turning itself off.

filter.name: Blocked music
filter.description: Music that's skipped as soon as it plays. One per line. The sidebar app can block anything that's played before with one tap.

data_description.blocked_tracks: Song — Artist, or just the song's name to block it by anyone. Versions like (Remastered) or - Live match too.
data_description.blocked_artists: Also blocks songs the artist features on.
data_description.blocked_sources: As the speaker reports them, such as YouTube Music or a radio station.
data_description.blocked_keywords: Whole words in a song's or album's title.
data_description.filter_action: Skipping goes to the next song, so the rest of the playlist keeps playing.

volume.name: Volume
volume.description: Keep the speaker from being turned up too loud.

data_description.max_volume: 100% means no cap. Turned straight back down if it goes higher.

announcements.name: Spoken warnings
announcements.description: Say when listening time is running out, and just before the music stops.

data_description.announce_tts: A text-to-speech entity, such as Piper or Google Translate.
data_description.announce_on_player: As an announcement over the music, on speakers that support it (Sonos, Google Cast, Music Assistant and others).

error.bad_quiet_windows: Quiet windows should look like 20:30-07:00 Bedtime, separated by commas.
error.announce_needs_voice: Pick a voice to say warnings with.

abort.already_configured: This speaker already has a Media Mgmt profile.
